name: Cybercrime & Internet Measurement
description: Empirical measurement of cybercrime, underground economies, abuse, fraud, and large-scale internet ecosystems.
narrative:
The earliest listed work in this area shows USENIX Security in 2018 already treating cybercrime as an economic system to be measured, not just a set of bugs to patch. "Plug and Prey? Measuring the Commoditization of Cybercrime via Online Anonymous Markets" (2018) quantified how attack capabilities were becoming off-the-shelf services on underground markets, while "An Empirical Analysis of Anonymity in Zcash" (2018) measured how well a privacy-focused cryptocurrency actually hid its users. Alongside these, the community was mapping abuse channels in everyday infrastructure, such as "End-to-End Measurements of Email Spoofing Attacks" (2018) and "Skill Squatting Attacks on Amazon Alexa" (2018), which tested how attackers exploit naming and trust gaps in widely deployed platforms.

By 2019 the focus broadened in two directions. One was the security of large software and device ecosystems, exemplified by "Small World with High Risks: A Study of Security Threats in the npm Ecosystem" (2019) and "All Things Considered: An Analysis of IoT Devices on Home Networks" (2019), both of which used large-scale empirical data to show systemic, supply-chain-style risk. The other was a critical, measurement-driven look at the defenses and data the industry itself relies on: "Reading the Tea leaves: A Comparative Analysis of Threat Intelligence" (2019) questioned how much commercial and open threat feeds actually agree, a thread continued by "A different cup of TI? The added value of commercial threat intelligence" (2020). This period also marked the area's turn toward human harm, with "Clinical Computer Security for Victims of Intimate Partner Violence" (2019) and later "The Tools and Tactics Used in Intimate Partner Surveillance" (2020) measuring how abuse plays out against real, vulnerable people rather than abstract systems.

Around 2020 phishing became a flagship measurement target, with longitudinal, ecosystem-scale studies replacing one-off snapshots. "Sunrise to Sunset: Analyzing the End-to-end Life Cycle and Effectiveness of Phishing Attacks at Scale" (2020) and "PhishTime: Continuous Longitudinal Measurement of the Effectiveness of Anti-phishing Blacklists" (2020) tracked how attacks evade detection over time, and "Catching Phishers By Their Bait" (2021) used phishing-kit detection to characterize a national threat landscape. Simultaneously, the blockchain and DeFi economy emerged as a rich new underground to measure, from scam mechanics in "The Art of The Scam: Demystifying Honeypots in Ethereum Smart Contracts" (2019) to market manipulation in "Frontrunner Jones and the Raiders of the Dark Forest" (2021).

Where the area stands now, in the most recent listed work, is a maturing of these threads into the security of complex deployed ecosystems and their lifecycles. "The Circle Of Life: A Large-Scale Study of The IoT Malware Lifecycle" (2021) measures malware end to end across the IoT population, echoing the supply-chain and device-fleet concerns raised earlier. The overall trajectory runs from measuring underground markets and currency anonymity, through auditing the ecosystems and defenses we depend on, to longitudinal studies of fraud, abuse, and human harm at internet scale.

milestones.title: Plug and Prey? Measuring the Commoditization of Cybercrime via Online Anonymous Markets
milestones.note: framed cybercrime as a commoditized service economy measurable through underground markets

milestones.title: An Empirical Analysis of Anonymity in Zcash
milestones.note: empirically tested whether a privacy cryptocurrency actually delivered the anonymity it promised

milestones.title: Small World with High Risks: A Study of Security Threats in the npm Ecosystem
milestones.note: exposed systemic supply-chain risk across a massive software package ecosystem at scale

milestones.title: Reading the Tea leaves: A Comparative Analysis of Threat Intelligence
milestones.note: turned a critical, measurement-driven lens on the threat-intelligence data defenders depend on

milestones.title: Clinical Computer Security for Victims of Intimate Partner Violence
milestones.note: pivoted the field toward measuring abuse and its impact on real, vulnerable people

milestones.title: Sunrise to Sunset: Analyzing the End-to-end Life Cycle and Effectiveness of Phishing Attacks at Scale
milestones.note: established large-scale, end-to-end longitudinal measurement as the standard for studying phishing

milestones.title: Frontrunner Jones and the Raiders of the Dark Forest: An Empirical Study of Frontrunning on the Ethereum Blockchain
milestones.note: measured market manipulation in the emerging DeFi economy as a new underground domain

milestones.title: The Circle Of Life: A Large-Scale Study of The IoT Malware Lifecycle
milestones.note: measured the full lifecycle of malware across the IoT device population at scale
